parameters.name: Service
parameters.description: Service product code. For custom events, fill in `saf_de` here.

parameters.name: ServiceParameters
parameters.description: Service input parameters, a JSON formatted string containing the complete JSON information. If it is a custom event, an `eventCode` attribute needs to be added here.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun saf execute-request --service-parameters accountId_:_1233000 --service account_abuse_pro --region cn-hangzhou
